name: spec
description: Spec pipeline v7 — a small code program run by a trusted engineer, verified by executed evidence. Lifecycle: /spec:genesis (greenfield) → roadmap briefs → /spec:mocks → /spec:plan → /spec:run (build, then review, each driver-stepped with one fresh-context reviewer and a derived verdict) → /spec:release; plus /spec:status, /spec:doctor, /spec:enforce, /spec:escape, /spec:replay. Changelog (last 3): 7.242.0 — /spec:connect makes the project and its token with the public terminal tool (npx walkthrough-cli whoami, new, token) instead of railway ssh, so anyone signed in with the tool can connect, not only the Railway owner; not signed in and not on the team are refused with the fix named, the tool never sees the plugin token, and --environment is gone (one hosted environment, production). 7.241.0 — mocks-driver retires a legacy (pre-schema-3) status.json itself — moved to design/mocks/status.legacy.json (never clobbered) and a fresh SEED status written — instead of printing an rm remedy; an APPROVED legacy file stays readable and is never moved. 7.240.0 — The old-test cleanup's --apply now fills a gateCommand's {testDirs}/{scopeDirs} with the test files it left in the folders it touched, instead of passing the placeholder to the shell; before, any project with a scoped gate saw every cleanup undone. This repo's 272 expired tests are retired.
